description: Farm Dam Boundaries is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. This dataset contains the digitised boundaries of all man made waterbodies (including farm dams) in southern Victoria and all larger man made waterbodies in northern Victoria using a combination of satellite and aerial imagery. Should be used in conjunction with FARMDAMSPOINT. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Inland waters. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
